source_quote: The calculated elimination half-lives of EP40111 and enfuvirtide were 10.4 h and 2.8 h, respectively.
route_quote: EP40111 or enfuvirtide (dose, 4 mg/kg of body weight) was injected intravenously via the cannula (two rats were used for each compound)
notes: Measured in this study (Fig. 3, LC-MS/MS, 4 mg/kg iv); only two rats per compound.
